payload.description: Ammo-versus-armor hit resolution for shooters and extraction games. Three ammo types (standard: medium pen/flesh; hollow point: low pen, high flesh; AP: high pen, low flesh unless it goes through armor first) and three armor classes (light/medium/heavy) with durability that wears per hit. Penetration chance from pen minus class plus wear; blocked hits do blunt damage. Zone multipliers; armor covers the torso (body/thorax/stomach). Feeds damage into the warehouse health part or body-parts.

payload.title: Escape from Slopov
payload.author: Escape from Slopov
payload.description: A realistic first-person extraction shooter in an abandoned town. Pick a loadout from your stash, deploy, loot crates, desks and bodies for cash, weapons, weapon parts, ammo, armor and medicine, then reach the single extraction flare alive, or lose everything you brought in. Three guns (AR-12 assault rifle, P-8 pump shotgun, M-91 bolt-action) with silencer, holographic sight and 4x scope; standard, hollow-point and armor-piercing ammo against light, medium and heavy armor; chest rigs (the only place you reload from) and backpacks; per-limb damage with instant-kill headshots; bandages and medkits; one trader who buys and sells everything. Enemies: fast fragile zombies, scavengers and better-equipped faction soldiers. Scavs and factions are allied, everyone fights zombies, and humans killed by zombies rise as zombies. Portable save codes keep your stash.
